mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rn, visit_data.* FROM ( SELECT v.member_no, m.member_id, m.name, m.nickname, m.role, v.ip_address, COUNT(*) AS visit_count, SUM(NVL(v.daily_request_count, 1)) AS request_count, MIN(v.created_date) AS first_visit_date, MAX(NVL(v.last_visit_date, v.created_date)) AS last_visit_date, MAX(v.request_uri) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NVL(v.last_visit_date, v.created_date), v.no ) AS last_request_uri, MAX(v.user_agent) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NVL(v.last_visit_date, v.created_date), v.no ) AS last_user_agent FROM visit_log v LEFT JOIN member m ON v.member_no = m.no WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member admin_member WHERE admin_member.no = v.member_no AND admin_member.role = 'ADMIN' ) AND ( #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(v.member_no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR v.ip_address LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.member_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' ) GROUP BY v.member_no, m.member_id, m.name, m.nickname, m.role, v.ip_address ORDER BY MAX(NVL(v.last_visit_date, v.created_date)) DESC ) visit_data WHERE ROWNUM <= #{offset} + #{size} ) WHERE rn > #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT v.member_no, v.ip_address FROM visit_log v LEFT JOIN member m ON v.member_no = m.no WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member admin_member WHERE admin_member.no = v.member_no AND admin_member.role = 'ADMIN' ) AND ( #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR TO_CHAR(v.member_no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR v.ip_address LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.member_id LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR m.nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' ) GROUP BY v.member_no, v.ip_address )

WITH today_data AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS visitor_count, NVL(SUM(NVL(v.daily_request_count, 1)), 0) AS request_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.member_no IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS member_count, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN v.member_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS guest_count FROM visit_log v WHERE v.created_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member admin_member WHERE admin_member.no = v.member_no AND admin_member.role = 'ADMIN' ) ), history_data AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(unique_visitor_count), 0) AS visitor_count, NVL(SUM(request_count), 0) AS request_count, NVL(SUM(member_visitor_count), 0) AS member_count, NVL(SUM(guest_visitor_count), 0) AS guest_count, MIN(stat_date) AS first_stat_date, MAX(stat_date) AS last_stat_date FROM visit_daily_stat ) SELECT today_data.visitor_count AS today_visitor_count, history_data.visitor_count + today_data.visitor_count AS total_daily_visitor_count, history_data.request_count + today_data.request_count AS total_request_count, history_data.member_count + today_data.member_count AS member_visitor_count, history_data.guest_count + today_data.guest_count AS guest_visitor_count, NVL( history_data.first_stat_date, CASE WHEN today_data.visitor_count > 0 THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) END ) AS first_stat_date, CASE WHEN today_data.visitor_count > 0 THEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) ELSE history_data.last_stat_date END AS last_stat_date FROM today_data CROSS JOIN history_data
